第15章 又偷偷一起吃饭不带我（第1页）
甜甜长相甜美可爱，扮相又符合年龄，谁见了都忍不住想抱一抱亲一亲。
甜甜立刻就难过得呜哇地哭了出来，更抱着容辞不放了。
容辞忙抱着人哄：“不是的甜甜，你一点都不恶心，反而漂亮又可爱，难道甜甜自己不这么觉得吗？”
甜甜听了，心情终于好了点，还没说话，封景心见容辞还抱着甜甜，还夸她漂亮可爱，眼眶立刻就红了：“你……我，我不喜欢你了，我不要你当妈妈了！”
她虽然生气，但不想在大庭广众之下指责她，让她丢脸。
她抱着她，亲了亲她：“好了，先别生气……”
封景心非常生气，可看到容辞亲她，她气消了一半，心里就更委屈了，忽然哭了出来，寸进尺地要求她：“那你……你以后不许抱她，也不许说她可爱！”
原来是她虽然不想要她这个妈妈了，但看到有人跟她抢，她又不乐意了。
她没有答应，但亲了亲她，安抚她的情绪，将两个孩子都抱远一些，离开了人群。
封景心趁机把甜甜挤出了容辞怀抱。
甜甜脾气挺好的，她虽然很喜欢容辞，但对容辞没有这么深的独占欲。
而且封景心看着很凶，她有点怕她。
容辞抱着封景心，温声说道：“心心，妈妈知道你现在很酷，可是每个人的审美是不同的。你喜欢酷酷帅帅的自己，可也有人喜欢可可爱爱，粉嫩甜美的自己，你不能因为别人的审美跟你不一样，就骂人家恶心难看，我们应该尊重每个人的审美和喜好——妈妈说的这些，你能明白的，对吗？”
她说了什么，其他小孩可能无法理解，但封景心一定能听明白。
可她就是见不得容辞抱其他小孩，对其他小孩好。
容辞揉了揉她的发端，拿出手帕温柔地给她擦眼泪：“做错事没关系的，改正就好——但以后都不能这样说别人了，知道吗？”
见容辞对她还是这么好，封景心心气顺了些，抱着她，靠她怀里吸着鼻子点头：“知道了。”

容辞笑了笑，亲了亲她的小脸，然后转头跟甜甜说道：“甜甜，她是心心，是阿姨的女儿，她已经知道错了，你愿意原谅她吗？”
甜甜是有些怕封景心的，可容辞很温柔，她也喜欢容辞，她就乖乖的点头：“嗯，我愿意的。”
“谢谢甜甜。”容辞笑，又看向女儿：“心心，你应该怎么做？”
封景心从容辞怀里抬头：“对不起。”
甜甜羞涩一笑：“没、没关系的……”
事情终于得到解决，容辞也松了一口气，带着两个孩子去了教室。
班主任把甜甜带走了，容辞蹲下来看着女儿，温柔地说道：“好了，没事了，先进课室里去好不好？”

Chapter 15 Secretly eating together without me again (Page 1)
Tiantian looks sweet and cute, and her appearance matches her age. Anyone who sees her can't help but want to hug and kiss her.
Tiantian was so sad that she burst into tears immediately, and she couldn't let go of Rong Ci.
Rong Ci hurriedly hugged and coaxed: "No, Tiantian, you are not disgusting at all, but you are beautiful and cute. Don't you think so yourself?"
Tiantian finally felt better after hearing this. Before she could say anything, Feng Jingxin's eyes immediately turned red when she saw Rong Ci still hugging Tiantian and praising her for being beautiful and cute: "You...I, I don't like you anymore, I don't want you to be my mother!"
Although she was angry, she didn't want to accuse her in public and embarrass her.
She hugged her and kissed her: "Okay, don't be angry yet..."
Feng Jingxin was very angry, but when she saw Rong Ci kissing her, her anger was half gone, and she felt even more aggrieved. Suddenly she burst into tears and demanded her more and more: "Then you...you are not allowed to hug her in the future, and you are not allowed to call her cute!"
It turned out that although she no longer wanted her as a mother, she was not happy when she saw someone snatching it from her.
She didn't agree, but kissed her to calm her down, took both children farther away, and left the crowd.
Feng Jingxin took the opportunity to squeeze Tiantian out of Rong Ci's arms.
Tiantian has a good temper. Although she likes Rong Ci very much, she does not have such a deep desire to possess Rong Ci.
Moreover, Feng Jingxin looked very fierce, and she was a little afraid of her.
Rong Ci hugged Feng Jingxin and said warmly: "Xinxin, mom knows that you are cool now, but everyone's aesthetics are different. You like yourself to be cool and handsome, but there are also people who like you to be cute, pink and sweet. You can't call others disgusting and ugly just because their aesthetics are different from yours. We should respect everyone's aesthetics and preferences - you can understand what mom said, right?"
Other children might not be able to understand what she said, but Feng Jingxin would definitely understand.
But she just couldn't bear to see Rong Ci hug other children and be nice to other children.
Rong Ci rubbed her hair, took out a handkerchief and wiped her tears gently: "It's okay if you do something wrong, just correct it - but you can't say that to others again, you know?"
Seeing that Rong Ci was still so kind to her, Feng Jing felt better, hugged her, sniffed in her arms and nodded: "I know."
Rong Ci smiled, kissed her little face, then turned to Tiantian and said, "Tiantian, she is Xinxin, her aunt's daughter. She already knows she was wrong. Are you willing to forgive her?"
Tiantian was a little afraid of Feng Jingxin, but Rongci was very gentle and she liked Rongci, so she nodded obediently: "Yes, I am willing."
"Thank you Tiantian." Rong Ci smiled and looked at her daughter: "Xinxin, what should you do?"
Feng Jingxin calmly raised her head from Ci's arms: "I'm sorry."
Tiantian smiled shyly: "No, it's okay..."
The matter was finally resolved, and Rong Ci breathed a sigh of relief and took the two children to the classroom.
The head teacher took Tiantian away. Rong Ci knelt down and looked at her daughter, and said softly: "Okay, it's okay. Can you go to the classroom first?"
